rows.state_failure_platform: Page changes update terminal visibility rather than killing shells. Full-width close restores dock state. This is cross-surface behavior, not just styling.

go_evidence.remaining: Native code exists; this row is not validated end to end.

rows.group: Workbench, Git, Review, worktrees, files and terminal
rows.feature: Workspace edits from agent, user, editor or Git refresh docked Review, visible Git status, Explorer, active Files tab, branch status and visible Worktrees list.
rows.interaction_contract: Workspace edits from agent, user, editor or Git refresh docked Review, visible Git status, Explorer, active Files tab, branch status and visible Worktrees list.
rows.state_failure_platform: Watch is 500 ms debounced; linked-worktree per-worktree/common Git dirs are watched separately. Generated trees, Git object/log/checkpoint scratch are excluded to prevent refresh loops. No watcher backend means manual refresh remains; startup retried after workspace change, not every heartbeat.

go_evidence.remaining: Native fsnotify recursive/trailing-debounce and bounded polling fallback pass Linux filesystem/race tests. Windows/macOS cross-compile only; real host event delivery, network filesystems and all UI refresh fan-out remain acceptance gates.
